# Orders

Part of the **Sales** API. Base URL `https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1` — replace the host with your own installation and the token placeholder with a real Bearer token (see [Authentication](/master/api-reference/authentication)).

## List orders

<Badge type="tip" text="GET" /> `/admin/api/v1/sales/orders`

Retrieve a paginated list of orders with filtering and sorting

> 🔒 Requires a valid Bearer token.


**Query parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description | Example |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|---------|
| `include` | string | No | Comma-separated list of relationships to include. Available options: partner, partnerInvoice, partnerShipping, user, team, company, currency, paymentTerm, fiscalPosition, journal, campaign, utmSource, medium, warehouse, lines, lines.product, lines.linkedSaleOrderSale, lines.uom, lines.productPackaging, lines.currency, lines.orderPartner, lines.salesman, lines.warehouse, lines.route, lines.company | `partner,lines` |
| `filter[id]` | string | No | Comma-separated list of IDs to filter by |  |
| `filter[state]` | string | No | Filter by state |  |
| `filter[partner_id]` | string | No | Comma-separated list of partner IDs to filter by |  |
| `filter[trashed]` | string | No | Filter by trashed status. Available options: with, only | `with` |
| `sort` | string | Yes | Sort field | `-created_at` |
| `page` | integer | Yes | Page number | `1` |



::: code-group

```bash [cURL]
curl -X GET "https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/sales/orders?include=partner%2Clines&filter%5Btrashed%5D=with&sort=-created_at&page=1" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}" \
  -H "Accept: application/json" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
```

```javascript [JavaScript]
const response = await fetch("https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/sales/orders?include=partner%2Clines&filter%5Btrashed%5D=with&sort=-created_at&page=1", {
  method: "GET",
  headers: {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}",
    "Accept": "application/json",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
  },
});

const data = await response.json();
console.log(data);
```

```php [PHP]
    'headers' => [
        'Authorization' => 'Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}',
```

## Create order

<Badge type="tip" text="POST" /> `/admin/api/v1/sales/orders`

Create a new order with line items

> 🔒 Requires a valid Bearer token.



**Body parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `partner_id` | integer | Yes | Customer (partner) ID. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `payment_term_id` | integer | Yes | Payment term ID. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `date_order` | string | Yes | Order date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Must be a valid date. |
| `validity_date` | string | No | Quotation validity date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Must be a valid date. |
| `commitment_date` | string | No | Must be a valid date. |
| `client_order_ref` | string | No | Must not be greater than 255 characters. |
| `origin` | string | No | Must not be greater than 255 characters. |
| `note` | string | No | Terms and conditions or internal note. |
| `user_id` | integer | No | Must match an existing stored value. |
| `company_id` | integer | No | Company ID. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `currency_id` | integer | No | Currency ID. Ignored when a price list is given, as the order then follows the price list currency. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `price_list_id` | integer | No | Price list ID. Its currency becomes the order currency, and its rules price any line sent without a unit price. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `campaign_id` | integer | No | Must match an existing stored value. |
| `utm_source_id` | integer | No | Must match an existing stored value. |
| `medium_id` | integer | No | Must match an existing stored value. |
| `sales_order_tags` | integer[] | No | Must match an existing stored value. |
| `lines` | object[] | Yes | Array of order line items with writable fields from the quotation form. Must have at least 1 items. |
| `lines[].id` | integer | No | Must match an existing stored value. |
| `lines[].product_id` | integer | Yes | Must match an existing stored value. |
| `lines[].product_qty` | number | Yes | Must be at least 0. Must not be greater than 99999999999. |
| `lines[].qty_delivered` | number | No | Must be at least 0. Must not be greater than 99999999999. |
| `lines[].product_packaging_qty` | number | No | Must be at least 0. Must not be greater than 99999999999. |
| `lines[].price_unit` | number | No | This field is required when price_list_id is not present. Must be at least 0. Must not be greater than 99999999999. |
| `lines[].discount` | number | No | Must be at least 0. Must not be greater than 100. |
| `lines[].customer_lead` | number | No | Must be at least 0. Must not be greater than 99999999999. |
| `lines[].product_uom_id` | integer | No | Must match an existing stored value. |
| `lines[].product_packaging_id` | integer | No | Must match an existing stored value. |
| `lines[].taxes` | integer[] | No | Must match an existing stored value. |


::: code-group

## Update order

<Badge type="tip" text="PUT" /> `/admin/api/v1/sales/orders/{id}`

Update an existing order and sync line items

> 🔒 Requires a valid Bearer token.

**Path parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | integer | Yes | The order ID |



**Body parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `partner_id` | integer | No | Customer (partner) ID. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `payment_term_id` | integer | No | Payment term ID. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `date_order` | string | No | Order date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Must be a valid date. |
| `validity_date` | string | No | Quotation validity date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Must be a valid date. |
| `commitment_date` | string | No | Must be a valid date. |
| `client_order_ref` | string | No | Must not be greater than 255 characters. |
| `origin` | string | No | Must not be greater than 255 characters. |
| `note` | string | No | Terms and conditions or internal note. |
| `user_id` | integer | No | Must match an existing stored value. |
| `company_id` | integer | No | Company ID. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `currency_id` | integer | No | Currency ID. Ignored when a price list is given, as the order then follows the price list currency. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `price_list_id` | integer | No | Price list ID. Its currency becomes the order currency, and its rules price any line sent without a unit price. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `campaign_id` | integer | No | Must match an existing stored value. |
| `utm_source_id` | integer | No | Must match an existing stored value. |
| `medium_id` | integer | No | Must match an existing stored value. |
| `sales_order_tags` | integer[] | No | Must match an existing stored value. |
| `lines` | object[] | No | Array of order line items with writable fields from the quotation form. Must have at least 1 items. |
| `lines[].id` | integer | No | Must match an existing stored value. |
| `lines[].product_id` | integer | Yes | Must match an existing stored value. |
| `lines[].product_qty` | number | Yes | Must be at least 0. Must not be greater than 99999999999. |
| `lines[].qty_delivered` | number | No | Must be at least 0. Must not be greater than 99999999999. |
| `lines[].product_packaging_qty` | number | No | Must be at least 0. Must not be greater than 99999999999. |
| `lines[].price_unit` | number | No | This field is required when price_list_id is not present. Must be at least 0. Must not be greater than 99999999999. |
| `lines[].discount` | number | No | Must be at least 0. Must not be greater than 100. |
| `lines[].customer_lead` | number | No | Must be at least 0. Must not be greater than 99999999999. |
| `lines[].product_uom_id` | integer | No | Must match an existing stored value. |
| `lines[].product_packaging_id` | integer | No | Must match an existing stored value. |
| `lines[].taxes` | integer[] | No | Must match an existing stored value. |


::: code-group


```php [PHP]
$response = $client->request('POST', 'https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/sales/orders/{id}/set-as-quotation', [
    'headers' => [
        'Authorization' => 'Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}',
        'Accept' => 'application/json',
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
    ],
]);

$data = json_decode($response->getBody(), true);
```

```python [Python]
import requests

url = "https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/sales/orders/{id}/set-as-quotation"

    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}",
    "Accept": "application/json",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
}

response = requests.post(url, headers=headers)

data = response.json()
print(data)
```

## Toggle sale order lock

<Badge type="tip" text="POST" /> `/admin/api/v1/sales/orders/{id}/toggle-lock`

Toggle lock status for a confirmed sale order

> 🔒 Requires a valid Bearer token.

**Path parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | integer | Yes | The order ID |




::: code-group

```bash [cURL]
curl -X POST "https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/sales/orders/{id}/toggle-lock" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}" \
  -H "Accept: application/json" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
```

```javascript [JavaScript]
const response = await fetch("https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/sales/orders/{id}/toggle-lock", {
  method: "POST",
  headers: {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}",
    "Accept": "application/json",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
  },
});

const data = await response.json();
console.log(data);
```
